DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @RootPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ProgramFilesPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @FolderPath VARCHAR(8000)

SET @EnvironName = (SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')
SET @RootPath = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'RootPath' AND EnvironName = @EnvironName),'')
SET @ProgramFilesPath = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'ProgramFilesPath' AND EnvironName = @EnvironName),'')
SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDT..EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'PreserviceExport')
SET @FolderPath = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FolderPath')


SELECT @RootPath + @FolderPath AS RootPathFolder, @JobId AS JobId, @ProgramFilesPath AS ProgramFilesPath

insert into EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims(ClaimID, ProviderID, ProviderAddressID, AddressBeginDate, ProviderAddress, ProviderPhone, ProviderName)
select 
 [ClaimID] = A.ClaimID
,[ProviderID] = D.PRPR_ID
,[ProviderAddressID] = E.PRAD_ID
,[AddressBeginDate] = E.PRAD_EFF_DT 
,ProviderAddress = E.PRAD_ADDR1
	+ CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_ADDR2) > 0 Then ', ' + E.PRAD_ADDR2 ELSE '' END
	+ CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_ADDR3) > 0 Then ', ' + E.PRAD_ADDR3 ELSE '' END
	+ CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_CITY) > 0 Then ' ' + UPPER(E.PRAD_CITY) ELSE '' END
	+ CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_STATE) > 0 Then ', ' + E.PRAD_STATE ELSE '' END
	+ CASE WHEN Len(LEFT(E.PRAD_ZIP,5)) > 0 Then ' ' + LEFT(E.PRAD_ZIP,5) ELSE '' END
	+ CASE WHEN Len(CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_ZIP)=9 THEN LEFT (E.PRAD_ZIP,4)ELSE ''END) > 0 Then '-' + CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_ZIP)=9 THEN LEFT (E.PRAD_ZIP,4)ELSE ''END  END

,[ProviderPhone] =CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_PHONE) > 0 
			Then E.PRAD_PHONE + CASE WHEN Len(E.PRAD_PHONE_EXT) > 0 Then 'x' + E.PRAD_PHONE_EXT Else '' END
	  ELSE '' END
,[ProviderName] = D.PRPR_NAME

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ClaimID FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberList) A
--INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM B (nolock)    on A.ClaimID = B.CLCL_ID  
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CLCL_ID, PRPR_ID FROM  ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CDML_CL_LINE) C   on A.ClaimID = C.CLCL_ID  
INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV D (nolock)     on C.PRPR_ID = D.PRPR_ID
INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS E (nolock)  on E.PRAD_ID = D.PRAD_ID				
											      AND E.PRAD_TYPE = D.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM 
												  AND E.PRAD_EFF_DT >= GETDATE ()----- to get primary address

Order by D.PRPR_ID, E.PRAD_EFF_DT DESC

SELECT	
		PROGNUM
		,AFFNUM
		,CASE 
			WHEN PROVIDERFULLNAME = '' THEN 'NO PROVIDER NAME' 
			ELSE PROVIDERFULLNAME 
		END AS 'PROVIDERFULLNAME'
FROM	EPSDT.DBO.EPSDTPROACTIVEMEMBERLIST(nolock) 
WHERE	PROGNUM <> 'DC' 
GROUP BY PROGNUM,AFFNUM,PROVIDERFULLNAME    
ORDER BY PROGNUM,AFFNUM,PROVIDERFULLNAME

SELECT	DISTINCT 
		ProgNum 
FROM	EPSDTProactiveMemberList(nolock) 
WHERE	PROGNUM <> 'DC'

SELECT	DISTINCT 
		ProgNum
		,AgeBand
		,CONVERT(INT, LEFT(AgeBand, CHARINDEX('-', Ageband, 1) - 1)) AS AgeOrder 
FROM	EPSDTProactiveMemberList(nolock) 
WHERE	PROGNUM <> 'DC'
ORDER BY 1 ,3 desc

SELECT	DISTINCT 
		ProgNum
		,AgeBand
		,CONVERT(INT, LEFT(AgeBand, CHARINDEX('-', Ageband, 1) - 1)) AS AgeOrder 
FROM	EPSDTProactiveMemberList(nolock) 
WHERE	PROGNUM = 'DC'
ORDER BY 1 ,3 desc
